title: Test Manager
description:
**Major Accountabilities**

* Establish and maintain standardized testing methodologies, frameworks, and tools
* Ensure appropriate test coverage, including functional, regression, integration, performance, and automated testing
* Oversee validation and documentation processes in alignment with GxP and other relevant regulatory requirements for assigned test cycles
* Defect Management, ensuring that defects are recorded, prioritized and resolved effectively.
* Perform risk assessments on defects that affect business-critical and GxP processes
* Contribute to test automation strategy to increase speed, efficiency, and repeatability in delivery.
* Collaborate with Business and Technology stakeholders, Factory and Platform teams to ensure successful test activities
* Define and monitor testing KPIs to assess quality, efficiency, and compliance of testing outcomes.

* Fluent English (spoken and written)

* Deep understanding of testing frameworks, test management tools, especially Opentext ALM and automated testing.

description:

This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.

Setup, develop and maintain detailed test scenarios, test suites, data, checklist and/or other documents as specified, ensuring test scenarios align to requirements, adhering to claim adjudication guidelines. title: Associate Software Quality & Test Analyst
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an Associate Software Quality and Test Analyst (Software Quality Analyst, Test Analyst, Computer System Validation Analyst) to join our life sciences and clinical research team. As an Associate Software Quality and Test Analyst, you will support software quality, system validation, testing, and compliance activities for regulated business applications. This position plays a key role in validation deliverables, change requests, test case creation and execution, and quality documentation, helping ensure that systems remain compliant and audit ready.
  
  
You'll collaborate with business, IT, Quality, and vendor teams, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to system enhancements and projects. Responsibilities include system validation support, test execution, quality documentation, change request support, and traceability, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence system quality and compliance outcomes.
  
  
You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through validation, testing, and quality activities that keep systems compliant, traceable, and inspection ready. Your work helps protect data integrity and the reliability of the systems that support the delivery of new therapies to patients. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Associate Software Quality and Test Analyst can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support system validation and qualification activities for software applications
* Develop and execute test cases, test scripts, and user acceptance testing (UAT) scenarios
* Create, review, and maintain validation and quality documentation.
* Support change request assessment, testing, and implementation activities
* Document test results, defects, and testing evidence
* Ensure traceability between requirements, testing, and validation deliverables
* Assist with audit readiness by maintaining accurate and inspection-ready records
* Collaborate with business, IT, Quality, and vendor teams on system enhancements and projects

**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Strengths in software testing and UAT, system validation, and quality documentation
* An understanding of regulated environments and the documentation and compliance standards they require
* The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly
* A patient-focused mindset and strong attention to detail
* Comfort working with change management and defect tracking processes

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related field
* 1-3 years of experience in software testing, validation, quality assurance, or related roles
* Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), software testing methodologies, and user acceptance testing (UAT) processes
* Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Computer System Validation (CSV)
* Knowledge of Good Practice (GxP), Good Automated Manufacturing Practice (GAMP 5), and FDA 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Electronic Signatures) requirements
* Experience with change control and quality management processes
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, ServiceNow, HP ALM, and similar tools

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
  
  
If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

title: Sr. BA II
description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.
  
  
**Job Description**
Invesco understands data and the products created from data are the lifeblood of our business. Data-first functions work together seamlessly to enable Invesco to achieve the true value of data and data products. Invesco leverages data as a strategic asset by making quality, trusted data and content available to the right people, at the right time, in the right format, in the most efficient way possible to enable both large transformations and day-to-day operations.
  
  
This Senior Business Analyst role sits within the Product Engagement part of our Digital, Distribution and Enterprise Engineering (D2E2) organization. They maintain good relationships with internal partners and collaborate with their peers across the Distribution business domain. They develop a strong understanding of the investments and distribution data and business processes, including both how it is produced and consumed across all Distribution channels and how to apply Invesco’s Data strategy and practices to drive Distribution’s data capabilities forward.
  
  
The focus of this position is to work closely with the business units to gain in-depth understanding of customer's business strategy, processes, services, roadmap and the context in which the business operates. This role will be key to understanding and documenting capabilities needed to address business challenges. Under the general supervision, gather business and data requirements, convert the business and data requirements into technical requirements for solution development. The senior business analyst supports the product owner(s) in managing the scope of the assigned project(s), resolves any impediments from requirements perspective for development team, supports the system testing and user acceptance testing. title: QA Engineer II
description:
**Overview**
As the QA Engineer on the Smart Water pod, you will own quality for a product being scaled into RealPage's standard meter-operations offering, and you will do it by writing test automation rather than clicking through manual passes. You will build automated coverage for the customer-facing Smart Water experience in the Smart Building Portal, the C#/.NET services behind it, and — critically — the accuracy of the meter and usage data flowing through the ingestion pipeline.
  
  
Smart Water's history of data-integrity and onboarding defects makes this a high-impact role: you will stand up the automated regression and data-validation suites that keep calculations correct (cost, usage, loss, occupancy), run in CI on every change, and prevent the kinds of issues that have delayed customer go-lives. A core goal of the pod is to move Smart Water off manual, PME-driven QA and onto repeatable automated tests.
  
  
This role suits a QA engineer who thinks like a developer — someone who reaches for a script before a manual test case and wants to build the automation foundation for a small, fast-moving pod.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain automated test suites (functional, regression, API, data-validation) as the primary way Smart Water is tested — integrated into the Azure DevOps CI pipeline to run on every change.
* Write automated UI and API tests across the Angular front end and C#/.NET services, replacing manual, repetitive test passes with scripted coverage.
* Automate data-integrity checks across the ingestion pipeline — meter reads, usage, cost, loss, and occupancy calculations — so regressions are caught in CI rather than by hand.
* Encode water-usage anomaly detection scenarios (running toilets, continuous-flow fixtures, abnormal usage) as automated test cases against known data.
* Automate verification of onboarding and self-service workflows to prevent the data and configuration defects that have historically required PMEs.
* Partner closely with the pod's developers on quality — reproducing issues, adding regression tests, and confirming fixes.
* Reserve exploratory/manual testing for genuinely new features, and convert what you learn there into automated coverage.

**Qualifications**
This is an automation-first QA role on a C#/.NET and Angular product — the goal is scripted, CI-integrated tests, not manual QA.
  
  

* 2+ years in software QA with a strong emphasis on test automation.
* Proven experience writing and maintaining automated tests (e.g., Selenium/Playwright/Cypress for UI, plus REST API test frameworks) — this is the core of the role.
* Comfortable writing code/scripts to test software, not just executing manual test cases.
* Strong SQL skills for automating data validation in MSSQL.
* Experience integrating automated tests into a CI/CD workflow (Azure DevOps or similar).
* Extensive hands-on experience with Claude Code or a similar agentic coding harness (required).
* Demonstrated experience with agentic coding workflows — using AI coding agents as part of day-to-day development (required).

**Preferred Required**
**Preferred Skills but not required**

* Experience testing data pipelines / ETL or analytics products where data accuracy is critical.
* Exposure to IoT, metering, or utility/submetering domains.
* Experience with ElasticSearch or performance testing.
* Familiarity with C#/.NET test tooling ( xUnit / NUnit ).

title: Manager GQS CSV & Digital Quality
description:

Serve as a senior subject matter expert for Computerized System Validation (CSV), Digital Quality, Data Integrity, AI Governance and digital compliance across the Sandoz organization. Provide quality and compliance oversight for GxP computerized systems, digital platforms, data solutions, AI capabilities and automation technologies throughout their lifecycle. Support the implementation of Compliance by Design, Quality by Design, digital transformation and process simplification initiatives while ensuring alignment with applicable regulatory requirements and industry best practices. Partner with Quality, Digital and IT stakeholders to enable compliant, efficient and sustainable digital solutions across Development, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain and Commercial functions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:
  
  
**CSV & Digital Quality Oversight**

* Provide quality oversight and guidance for GxP computerized systems, digital platforms, data solutions, AI capabilities and automation technologies.
* Support implementation and maintenance of CSV and Digital Quality frameworks, standards and procedures.
* Ensure validation and compliance activities are conducted in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements and internal standards.
* Contribute to regulatory inspections, audits and remediation activities related to computerized systems and digital solutions.

**Compliance & Risk Management**

* Support compliance with global GxP requirements, Annex 11, 21 CFR Part 11, Data Integrity principles, GAMP5, CSA and applicable AI regulations.
* Perform risk assessments and support risk-based validation approaches for computerized systems and digital solutions.
* Review validation documentation and ensure compliance throughout the system lifecycle.
* Identify potential compliance gaps and support implementation of corrective and preventive actions.

**End-to-End Digital Quality Support**

* Maintain oversight of assigned digital solutions, computerized systems, interfaces and supporting processes.
* Support lifecycle activities including requirements, validation, implementation, operation, monitoring, change management and retirement.
* Drive standardization and harmonization of validation practices and digital quality processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve compliance, efficiency and effectiveness through digitalization, automation and modern validation approaches.
* undefined

**AI, Data & Automation Quality Assurance**

* Provide quality oversight for AI, Generative AI, advanced analytics and intelligent automation solutions used in GxP-relevant processes.
* Support qualification, validation, monitoring and lifecycle management activities for AI-enabled solutions.
* Assess compliance risks associated with digital innovations and recommend appropriate controls.
* Support implementation of governance requirements for explainability, traceability and data integrity.

**Business Partnership & Project Support**

* Partner with Quality, Digital, IT and Business functions to ensure quality and compliance requirements are appropriately incorporated into digital initiatives.
* Participate in project teams as Digital Quality subject matter expert.
* Support deployment of new digital solutions and system enhancements.
* Provide guidance and training on CSV, Digital Quality and Data Integrity requirements.

**Continuous Improvement & Knowledge Management**

* Monitor regulatory developments, industry trends and emerging technologies relevant to CSV and Digital Quality.
* Support development and maintenance of standards, procedures, templates and best practices.
* Contribute to inspection readiness, continuous improvement initiatives and knowledge-sharing communities.
* Promote risk-based and pragmatic compliance approaches aligned with business objectives.

**Key Performance Indicators**
**Compliance & Inspection Readiness**

* Successful support of inspections, audits and compliance assessments.
* Timely closure of digital quality observations and CAPAs.
* Inspection readiness of assigned systems and digital solutions.

**Digital Quality Excellence**

* Adoption of risk-based validation and CSA approaches.
* Timely completion of validation deliverables and quality reviews.
* Improved standardization and efficiency of validation activities.

**Digital Transformation Support**

* Effective support of digital initiatives and system implementations.
* Integration of Compliance by Design principles into project delivery.
* Positive stakeholder feedback and business partnership.

**AI & Digital Governance**

* Timely completion of AI and digital compliance assessments.
* Effective support of AI governance requirements.
* Sustainable implementation of compliant digital innovations.

**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**

* 10-15 years of overall experience with significant experience in CSV, Digital Quality, IT Quality or GxP Compliance within the pharmaceutical industry.
* Strong understanding of global regulations and Health Authority expectations governing computerized systems validation, lifecycle management, Data Integrity and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements.
* Experience supporting development, implementation and lifecycle management of computerized systems in regulated environments.
* Experience with Cloud, SaaS, digital and AI-enabled platforms used in GxP environments.
* Experience with validation and quality oversight of systems such as SAP, ERP, Veeva, MES, LIMS, CDS and related platforms.
* Understanding of AI, Generative AI and advanced analytics deployment within regulated environments.
* Experience working in cross-functional and global project teams.
* Experience supporting supplier qualification and computerized system compliance activities.
* Strong communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
* Proven ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a complex matrix environment

**Why Sandoz?**
Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world’s medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more, so that everyone can achieve the basic human right of access to good healthcare.
  
  
With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low-cost, high-quality medicines, sustainably.
  
  
Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
  
  
  
  
Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster.
  
  
**Commitment To Diversity & Inclusion**
We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

title: Murex Front Office Consultant
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Murex Front Office SME to join our Capital Markets technology team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for leading the analysis, design, configuration, and support of our Murex platform, focusing on front-office modules. You will act as a key liaison between trading desk users, business analysts, and the technical development team to ensure that the Murex system effectively supports our trading, risk management, and pricing activities across various asset classes.

**Responsibilities:**

* Business Analysis and Requirements Gathering:
* Serve as the primary functional expert for the Murex Front Office modules, engaging directly with traders and other front-office stakeholders.
* Analyze business processes, gather requirements for new functionalities, and perform gap analysis to determine the optimal solution within the Murex platform.
* Translate business needs into clear functional specifications for the development and configuration teams.
* Murex Configuration and Implementation:
* Configure and test Murex to meet business requirements for front-office functions, including pricing, trade capture, and market data management.
* Build and maintain E-tradepad templates, pricing patterns, and booking workflows for various financial products.
* Develop and implement pre-trade rules and workflows to ensure compliance and automation.
* Production Support and Troubleshooting:
* Provide expert-level support to front-office users for any issues related to trading, pricing, or position mismatches.
* Analyze and resolve complex system issues, using tools like Simulation Viewer, e-Tradepad, and Datamart to investigate discrepancies.
* Ability to analyze pre-trade and amend or write new pre-trade rules
* Manage and prioritize production incidents, ensuring timely and effective resolution.
* Project and Change Management:
* Lead or participate in strategic projects related to Murex upgrades, new product launches, or regulatory initiatives.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive system integration, data migration, and testing efforts.
* Provide estimates and updates for the front-office delivery stream and contribute to project status reports.
* User Training and Documentation:
* Prepare and deliver training sessions and user guides to help front-office staff maximize their use of the Murex platform.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations, workflows, and functional specifications.

**Profile**

* Minimum of 8 years of experience in working with the Murex platform, with a strong focus on front-office implementation and support.
* Proven experience as a Murex Business Analyst or Consultant within the capital markets industry.
* Strong functional knowledge of at least two asset classes, such as Interest Rate Derivatives (IRD), FX Derivatives (FXD), Equities (EQ), or Commodities.
* Murex Modules Expertise:
* In-depth knowledge of Murex Front Office modules, including:
* E-tradepad
* Simulation Viewer
* Pre-Trade Workflow
* Market Data
* Datamart and reporting tools
* Technical Skills:
* Proficiency in SQL (Oracle/Sybase) for data analysis and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with financial concepts related to pricing, valuation, risk management, sensitivities (Greeks), and P&L.
* Experience with scripting languages (e.g., Python, VBA) and Unix commands is a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage complex issues under pressure.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Proactive, collaborative, and able to work independently or as part of a team.
* Experience with Murex's regulatory modules, such as FRTB, VaR (MRA/MRB), and xVA.
* Prior experience with Flex API or other integration capabilities within Murex.
* Familiarity with DevOps tools and CI/CD integration.

title: Senior eClinical Business Lead, IRT & DHT Design Consultant
description:
**About Parexel**
 Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights\-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000\+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient\-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
   

  

 We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose \-\- moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a Senior eClinical Business Lead (IRT and DHT Design Consultant). As a Senior eClinical Business Lead, you will support clinical research activities that advance new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in RTSM and DHT study design, requirements analysis, stakeholder collaboration, and clinical trial optimization. You'll collaborate with cross\-functional teams, follow industry\-standard processes, and contribute to study operations from planning through closeout. Responsibilities include providing expert consultation on digital health technology implementation, translating complex requirements into actionable solutions, and ensuring seamless integration across clinical trial systems.
   

  

 You'll join a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through advancing clinical trial technology, improving study efficiency, and enhancing patient engagement. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior eClinical Business Lead can explore career paths and expand expertise across clinical research and digital health innovation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Provide expert consultation to project leaders and study teams on RTSM and DHT study design, requirements gathering, and system configuration
* Analyze protocols and collaborate with stakeholders to develop, review, and validate user requirements that align with study design objectives and regulatory standards
* Identify, assess, and mitigate risks related to RTSM and DHT implementation, ensuring compliance with clinical trial processes and data integrity standards
* Translate complex technical and business requirements into clear, actionable guidance for study teams and system users to facilitate informed decision\-making
* Evaluate system integrations and proactively identify potential issues with third\-party interfaces, data flows, and user requirements to ensure seamless functionality
* Partner with UAT leads to design, execute, and validate testing protocols, ensuring systems meet defined requirements and business objectives
* Stay current on emerging RTSM and DHT technologies, industry best practices, and regulatory developments to drive continuous improvement and innovation
* Manage quality assurance and timely delivery of project deliverables while implementing corrective actions to maintain excellence
* Interact with external clients to discuss RTSM and DHT design considerations, protocol requirements, and implementation strategies
* Demonstrate proactive problem\-solving and deliver timely, effective solutions to client challenges and technical issues


**Candidate Profile**
**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**
* Deep expertise in RTSM and DHT systems, clinical trial design, and requirements management
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with the capacity to work independently and escalate appropriately
* Experience working in clinical research, healthcare, or a regulated environment
* Exceptional ability to collaborate across teams and communicate complex concepts clearly to diverse audiences
* Patient\-focused mindset with strong attention to detail and commitment to data integrity
* Comfort working with RTSM platforms, digital health technology (DHT) solutions, and clinical trial management systems (CTMS)


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
* 5\+ years of experience in building RTSM and/or DHT clinical trial systems, developing user requirements, and managing requirements gathering, configuration, design, and user acceptance testing
* Knowledge of ICH\-GCP, regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes
* Excellent technical and data standards knowledge with proven experience applying data standards in clinical trial environments
* Demonstrated ability to create and explain business processes and train others on implementation
* Strong communication, organization, and problem\-solving skills


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of industry standards such as CDISC SDTM and other data standards relevant to clinical trials
* Experience with eCOA or ePRO systems and digital health technology platforms
* Proven track record of conducting root cause analysis and driving process improvement initiatives
* Demonstrated client\-focused approach with ability to build and maintain strong client relationships


 We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
   

  

 If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be perfect fit, send them the link to apply!
